protocol.max_tokens: Keep frozen planner/provider default; no new output limit
protocol.sole_treatment: Official _planner_catalogue projection vs identity/deepcopy, for available_compositions and operation_program only
protocol.selection_rule: First five numeric layouts used in prior suite, fixed before new outcomes; no success-based selection
protocol.scope: Developmental mechanism pilot and repeated same-layout evaluation; not independent held-out generalization
primary_metrics: Provider prompt and total tokens per attempted case
protocol.failure_rule: Keep planning and execution failures in denominator; do not remap or retry semantic failures; preserve native transport retry policy up to3 with full ledger; infrastructure failure pauses controller for review
protocol.continuation_gate: After first10 cases, verify no infrastructure faults and unchanged sources, then execute two declared repeats irrespective of success direction

No online learning, System2 skill evolution, or comparison to an external project is included.

selection_summary.definition: composition plus ordered operations; rationale and other metadata are ignored

latency_definitions.api_seconds_difference: projected minus unprojected sum of transport attempts[].seconds; consistent with condition api.api_seconds
latency_definitions.logical_call_seconds_difference: projected minus unprojected replay row.seconds; includes retry backoff and local call processing
latency_definitions.overlap: Transport duration and logical call latency overlap; do not add them.

notes: This is a developmental comparison on the same five layouts, not a new held-out evaluation.
Full projection restores static task-label/code identities; it is not pure prompt compression and can change output selection.
Native evaluator outcomes are the success authority. Contract-valid plans and replay calls are not robot successes.

All 15 planned attempts per condition remain in the success denominator, including planning and execution failures. Infrastructure failures invalidate the comparison and remain visible in that denominator.
There are five layout units and three repeat measurements per layout. Paired repeat effects are descriptive; no confidence interval treats the repeats as independent layouts.
Cached tokens are a subset of input tokens; reasoning tokens are a subset of output tokens. Neither is added to total tokens.
Token sums include provider-reported usage for every recorded transport attempt, including failed attempts. Missing provider usage is disclosed and is not evidence of zero billed tokens.
Replay compares identical saved observations only when every pair audit explicitly verifies identity and source pin verification is explicit. Replay has no native execution.
API latency, action-batch latency, native execution, and wrapper wall time overlap and must not be added together.
Cold-start time is wrapper start through policy readiness, including configuration/loading; it does not isolate weight loading alone.

runtime_definitions.cold_start_until_policy_ready_seconds: policy_ready_seconds - wrapper start (0); includes configuration and model load
runtime_definitions.native_client_elapsed_seconds: native_finished_seconds - client_started_seconds; overlaps startup and execution
runtime_definitions.wrapper_overhead_seconds: launch gap + simulator startup + teardown; excludes cold start and native execution

correction_scope: replay transport API timing differences and separate logical-call timing
